findings.evidence: Lines 230–234 define `discr_formClass`; `rg -n "signedDiscr_formClass" code/TauCeti` has no hit, while the file develops both invariants in parallel.
findings.fix: Export `signedDiscr_formClass` with the signed weight-product formula, parallel to `discr_formClass`.
findings.issue: Only `discr_formClass` computes an invariant of an arbitrary regular form from a diagonalization; there is no parallel `signedDiscr_formClass`, forcing form-level consumers to manually rewrite through `formClass_mk` and quotient presentations.

findings.evidence: `discr_add` at line 113 and `signedDiscr_mul` at line 210 are `@[simp]`, but `signedDiscr_add` at line 199 is unannotated.
findings.fix: Mark `signedDiscr_add` with `@[simp]`; its right-hand side strictly decomposes the sum and does not recreate the redex.
findings.issue: The characteristic orthogonal-sum rule `signedDiscr_add` lacks `@[simp]`, unlike `discr_add` and `signedDiscr_mul`, so simplification does not normalize signed discriminants of sums.

summary: The signed discriminant surface lacks the form-level computation lemma and normal-form automation provided for the parallel discriminant API.
